prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer in Dallas for every truck-accident case — the right attorney depends on your case details (seriousness of injuries, liability issues, insurers involved, whether the truck is commercial/owner-operator, etc.) and your priorities (trial readiness, communication style, budget). That said, you’ll want a lawyer who specifically handles commercial truck collisions and has the resources and track record to take on trucking companies and their insurers.

Quick checklist — look for an attorney who:
- Regularly handles commercial truck cases (not just car wrecks).
- Knows truck-specific law and federal regulations (FMCSA) and how to obtain driver logs, ELD data, maintenance and carrier safety records.
- Has experience with accident reconstruction and access to experts (reconstructionists, biomechanical, medical).
- Has a proven record of settlements/verdicts in truck cases and trial experience.
- Has adequate staffing/resources to investigate quickly (preserve evidence, subpoena data).
- Is communicative and transparent about fees, costs, timeline, and who will handle your case.
- Is in good standing with the State Bar of Texas (no serious disciplinary history).

Practical resources to find top attorneys:
- State Bar of Texas “Find a Lawyer” and disciplinary records.
- Super Lawyers and SuperLawyers “Top Lists” for Dallas.
- Martindale-Hubbell peer-review ratings.
- Avvo/Google reviews and client testimonials (use as one factor, not the only one).
- Texas Trial Lawyers Association / National Trial Lawyers listings.

Good questions to ask in a free consultation:
- How many truck/tractor-trailer cases have you handled?
- Have you litigated truck cases against carriers/insurers and tried them to verdict?
- What were your representative settlements/verdicts in truck cases?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day — you or another attorney/associate?
- How do you charge (contingency fee %) and who pays costs if we lose?
- What will you need from me, and how long do you expect this to take?
- Do you use accident reconstruction and what experts do you retain?
- Have you handled claims involving FMCSA violations, ELD data, driver logs?

Other immediate steps after a truck crash:
- Get medical care and keep records.
- Report to police and get a copy of the crash report.
- Preserve evidence (photos, videos, clothing, vehicle damage).
- Note driver, carrier, plate, and insurer info.
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers without counsel.
- Be aware Texas statute of limitations: generally 2 years for personal injury (act promptly).

If you’d like, I can:
- Provide a short list of well-reviewed Dallas lawyers/firms who handle truck accidents (I’ll need your ZIP or neighborhood), or
- Draft a short email/phone script you can use when contacting attorneys for consultations.

Which would you prefer?
